tracks.name: Drums - Tight Club Kit
tracks.description: A straight, loud club groove: four-on-floor kick, sharp clap, offbeat hats, and phrase fills.

tracks.name: Perc - Minimal Top Loop
tracks.description: Small syncopated percussion gives the groove its rolling club motion.

tracks.name: Bass - Rolling Operator
tracks.description: A short, repeating mono bass phrase locks into the kick and gives the loop its identity.

tracks.name: Stabs - Wavetable Chord Shots
tracks.description: Sparse chord shots add harmonic color while keeping the low end and drums dominant.

tracks.name: Hook - One-Shot Synth Motif
tracks.description: A tiny repeated motif creates the earworm while leaving room for vocal chops or samples later.
